chair.name: Council Chair
chair.description: Synthesises member opinions into a single structured assessment.

moderator.name: Council Moderator
moderator.description: Decides which member speaks next. Routing only - never produces content.

members.name: Legal and Statutory Powers
members.description: Tests whether the proposal has a lawful basis, fits existing statutory powers, or requires new authority. Treats unresolved legal vires as a substantive constraint, not a drafting issue.

members.name: Finance and Value for Money
members.description: Tests affordability, whole-life cost, and whether the benefits case remains credible against the delivery plan. Challenges contingency where it weakens value for money or hides uncertainty.

members.name: Operational Delivery
members.description: Tests whether the proposal can be implemented and operated with available people, processes, suppliers, and systems. Defends sufficient contingency where delivery evidence shows material uncertainty.

members.name: Information Rights and Data Protection
members.description: Tests the lawful basis for data use, inter-body sharing, retention, transparency, and individual rights. Challenges data ambitions that exceed a defined and proportionate service need.

members.name: Security and Resilience
members.description: Tests the threat surface, dependency graph, resilience design, and response to failure. Challenges integrations and shared components that widen systemic exposure without proportionate controls.

members.name: Service Owner
members.description: Represents end users and the people who must operate within the outcome. Presses for usable, joined-up services while accepting only data use that can be justified and governed.
